# club.fernan.api

> Unofficial, educational Java client for the fernan.club REST API. Java 17+,
> Gson only, asynchronous. Not run or endorsed by fernan.club.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/README.md): Install, quickstart, endpoints, errors.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/CLAUDE.md): How to use and change the library.
- [DISCLAIMER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/DISCLAIMER.md): What this project is not, and who is responsible for what.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Pull requests, commits, code conventions.
- [SECURITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/CHANGELOG.md): Changes per version.

## Examples

- [MinimalExample.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/examples/MinimalExample.java): Fetch the user and print the balance.
- [AltManagerExample.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/examples/AltManagerExample.java): Full purchase flow that hands delivered accounts to the host app.
- [ErrorHandlingExample.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/examples/ErrorHandlingExample.java): Handling `RATE_LIMITED` and `COOLDOWN`.

## Core source

- [FernanClient.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/FernanClient.java): Top-level facade exposing the five services.
- [FernanClientBuilder.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/FernanClientBuilder.java): Builder with `apiKey`, `userAgent`, `integration`, `baseUrl`, `connectTimeoutMillis`, `onApiKeyChange`, `executor`.
- [FernanException.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/exception/FernanException.java): Single exception class for all API errors.
- [ErrorType.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/exception/ErrorType.java): Error categories to switch on.
- [ReferralChoice.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/model/referral/ReferralChoice.java): Required on every purchase: `of(code)` or `none()`.
- [IntegrationSignal.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/integration/IntegrationSignal.java): Optional `X-Integration` header.

## Services

- [UserService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/UserService.java): `me`, `apiKey`, `regenerateApiKey` (switches the client key and calls `onApiKeyChange`), `redeemKey`.
- [StoreService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/StoreService.java): `stock`, `cooldowns`, `purchase`, `purchases`, `purchaseDetail`, `validateReferral`.
- [RefundService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/RefundService.java): `create`, `cancel`, `list`, `get`.
- [ReferralService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/ReferralService.java): `create`, `list`, `stats`, `toggle`, `delete` (undocumented API).
- [HealthService.java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/club.fernan.api/main/src/main/java/club/fernan/api/service/HealthService.java): `get`, `simple`.
